steps.title: Pre-execute
steps.desc: tools/pre-execute waterfall: hooks, permission, sandbox return allow/deny/ask.

steps.title: Guards
steps.desc: Monotonic ctx.tools.guard() checks run after pre-execute; they can only deny or abstain.

steps.title: Execute wrapper
steps.desc: tools/execute wraps dispatch — the documented home for timeout, retry, and metrics.

steps.title: Tool body
steps.desc: The registered execute() body runs, carrying the caller-owned AbortSignal.

steps.title: Post-execute
steps.desc: tools/post-execute may accept, block, replace content, or attach model-facing context.

steps.title: Finalize and observe
steps.desc: finalizeContent enforces the content-only invariant; tools/result then observes the frozen outcome.
